newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bouygues Offshore sells Mexican unit.
newsitem.headline: Bouygues Offshore sells Mexican unit.

text.p: French oil services group Bouygues Offshore said on Tuesday it sold its Mexican Bosnor unit to Servicios Maritimos de Campeche of Mexico for $5 million.
"Bouygues Offshore received $5 million for this transaction," the company said in a statement. Bosnor made profit of 1.6 million francs on sales of 45 million in 1996.
Bouygues Offshore is a unit of construction group Bouygues.

Bouygues Offshore chairman Ivan Replumaz said in a statement the sale was in line with the company's aim of getting out of oil and gas fabrication activity in Mexico to focus on turnkey projects management and offshore installation activities.
